mapper.select: SELECT t.todo_id, t.due_date, tt.todo_type_id, tt.name AS todo_type_name, tt.color_code, mp.member_plant_id, p.name AS plant_name FROM todo t JOIN todo_type tt ON t.todo_type_id = tt.todo_type_id LEFT JOIN todo_member_plant tmp ON t.todo_id = tmp.todo_id LEFT JOIN member_plant mp ON tmp.member_plant_id = mp.member_plant_id AND mp.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN plant p ON mp.plant_id = p.plant_id AND p.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.due_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY t.due_date ASC, tt.todo_type_id ASC
SELECT todo_type_id AS todoTypeId, name AS typeName, color_code AS colorCode FROM todo_type ORDER BY todo_type_id ASC

SELECT mp.member_plant_id AS memberPlantId, p.name AS plantName FROM member_plant mp LEFT JOIN plant p ON mp.plant_id = p.plant_id WHERE mp.member_id = #{memberId} AND mp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY mp.member_plant_id ASC
